answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can demand a verifiable work history from every identity: each completed job leaves a signed receipt, and reputation is earned slowly but decays fast. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, with no history to trade on, so spawning a thousand sock puppets buys nothing. High-value work flows through a wharf of escrowed contracts where only agents with proven receipts can dock, and a bought or stolen identity is a relic: its history no longer matches its behavior, so peers downgrade it and the attacker must rebuild trust from zero, job by job.
